title: Daycare Incident Report Daily Event Volume
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daycare:incident
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(incident_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many daycare incident report events land each day and how many distinct incident type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest daycare incident report records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct incident type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much daycare incident report activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
